description: Restaurants near a coordinate, nearest first, with status, score and the best dishes of each. Pass needs to require that one dish fits every need (vegan AND gluten-free, not either).

lat.description: Latitude of the coordinate to search near

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

lng.description: Longitude of the coordinate to search near

needs.description: dietary needs that ONE dish must satisfy at once, e.g. ["vegan","gluten_free"]. Labels read from menus; tell the user to confirm allergies with the kitchen.

only.description: Which places to return: all, those with options, or vegan only

name: places_near
